explanationUrdu: درست جواب A sudden unexpected event ہے۔ یہ محاورہ اچانک اور غیر متوقع خبر یا واقعے کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

references.label: A bolt from the blue
references.claimSummary: Cambridge Dictionary supports that a bolt from the blue means a sudden unexpected event.

references.label: A bolt from the blue
references.claimSummary: Merriam-Webster supports that a bolt from the blue means a sudden unexpected event.

question: Before signing the contract, I should ___ its contents to avoid a mistake.
questionUrdu: Contract پر دستخط سے پہلے غلطی سے بچنے کے لیے اس کے contents کو ___ کرنا چاہیے۔
explanationUrdu: درست جواب Look through ہے۔ Look through کا مطلب مواد کو پڑھ کر یا دیکھ کر جانچنا ہے۔

references.label: Look through something
references.claimSummary: Cambridge defines look through something as reading it quickly.

references.label: Look through
references.claimSummary: Merriam-Webster independently defines look through as reading or briefly examining pages or a collection.

sourceNotes: Articles and possessives were repaired. Of the listed phrasal verbs, look through uniquely means to read or examine the contents.

question: Which phrasal verb means to examine something quickly but carefully?
questionUrdu: کون سا phrasal verb کسی چیز کو جلد مگر توجہ سے جانچنے کے معنی دیتا ہے؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب Look over ہے۔ Look over کا مطلب کسی چیز کا جائزہ یا معائنہ کرنا ہے۔

references.label: Look over
references.claimSummary: Cambridge Dictionary supports that look over means to examine something.

references.label: Look over
references.claimSummary: Merriam-Webster supports that look over means to examine something.

question: Which listed part of speech belongs to a closed class rather than an open class in English?
questionUrdu: English میں درج parts of speech میں کون سا open class کے بجائے closed class ہے؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب Pronoun ہے۔ Pronouns کی محدود grammatical فہرست ہوتی ہے، اس لیے یہ closed class ہیں۔

references.label: The Study of Meaning, Chapter 1
references.claimSummary: The UCL teaching text identifies content words as an open class and function words as a closed class.

references.label: Grammatical Coding System manual
references.claimSummary: The UCLA linguistics manual explicitly excludes pronouns from its open-class lexical items and treats them as closed-class items.

sourceNotes: Grammar was normalized. Nouns, lexical verbs and adverbs are open-class choices here; pronouns are closed-class.

question: Which listed part of speech is normally an open class in English?
questionUrdu: English میں درج parts of speech میں کون سا عموماً open class ہے؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب Noun ہے۔ Nouns میں نئے الفاظ مسلسل شامل ہو سکتے ہیں، اس لیے یہ open class ہیں۔

references.label: The Study of Meaning, Chapter 1
references.claimSummary: University College London supports that nouns normally form an open word class in English.

references.label: Grammatical Coding System manual
references.claimSummary: University of California, Los Angeles supports that nouns normally form an open word class in English.
